desc.en: It's said that this rodent has a mysterious trait of digging deep into the ground, and covering its body in bedrock. This troublesome creature rolls about as it pleases, smashing anything it hits along its path.
desc.ja: 地中深くに潜り、その岩盤を身につけて地上に出てくるという、不思議な習性をもっている。気ままに転がり、ぶつかる様々なものを粉砕してまわる迷惑なヤツ
